I have written EEx and HEEx in 4 public repositories, from 2024 to 2026.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2), [AI engineering](@/projects/ai.md) (1) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [the-psycho](@/work/the-psycho.md); [sig](@/work/sig.md): distributed cognitive framework in Elixir/OTP; [korczis.gitlab.io](@/work/korczis-gitlab-io.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses EEx and HEEx: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links EEx and HEEx to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
